output.subject: Your question about belongings in your repossessed car
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us. You told us that your car was repossessed and that, while you understand why, your work tools and your son's car seat are still inside it. You mentioned that you start a new job on 9/13/2026 and need your tools for it, and you asked how you can get your belongings back.

We understand how much these items matter to you, both for starting your new job and for your son, and we're sorry for the stress this situation is causing.

We have passed your message to our Collections & Recoveries team, who will review your question and respond within 10 business days. If there is anything else you would like us to know in the meantime, such as other items in the car, please reply to this message and we will add it to your file.

We wish you all the best with your new job.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer starts a new job on 9/13/2026 and needs the work tools; check whether a 10-business-day reply would arrive too late and whether to contact them sooner.
Add the actual process for retrieving personal property from a repossessed vehicle (who to contact, where the vehicle is held, any timelines or requirements); the draft does not describe it.
Confirm the vehicle's current status and location, and whether the belongings are still in it or have already been removed and stored.
A child's car seat is involved; consider whether it can be returned quickly given the customer's childcare needs.
Customer accepts the repossession itself and is not disputing it; the request is limited to recovering personal belongings.
